organization.title: Northstar Civic Lab
organization.content:
ABOUT

Northstar Civic Lab researches practical ways for local governments to make public services easier to use. The team combines field interviews, service design, and careful analysis of resident feedback.

KEY CONTACTS

  • Editorial and research partnership
  • Quarterly impact review

person.title: Maya Chen
person.content:
CONTACT INFO

Maya leads partnerships and coordinates the research calendar.

NOTES

Prefers a concise written brief before a working session.

topic.title: Civic service design
topic.content:
DESCRIPTION

Research, writing, and implementation patterns for improving the experience of public services.

projects.title: Resident Services Field Guide
projects.content:
OVERVIEW

A field guide for teams improving resident-facing services, grounded in interviews and repeatable delivery patterns.

GOALS

  • Complete the interview synthesis
  • Publish a useful first edition

projects.title: Transit Access Explainer
projects.content:
OVERVIEW

An explanatory package that turns transit access data into a clear public story without losing important context.

GOALS

  • Validate the data narrative
  • Prepare a reader-facing draft

tasks.title: Synthesize resident interview themes
tasks.content: Group the interview notes by recurring service friction, record representative evidence, and identify the questions that still need follow-up.

tasks.title: Draft the field guide introduction
tasks.content: Write an inviting introduction that explains the problem, names the intended audience, and previews how the guide can be used in a real project.

tasks.title: Confirm interview consent language
tasks.content: Verify that the published guide uses the approved consent language and does not expose identifying details.

tasks.title: Reconcile service taxonomy with the research archive
tasks.content: Compare the working taxonomy with the archived interview index and document any terms that have drifted since the first research pass.

meeting.title: Field guide editorial working session
meeting.content:
AGENDA

  • Review the interview synthesis
  • Decide which examples belong in the first edition

NOTES

Bring the annotated research summary and the latest outline.

ACTION ITEMS
